newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Inespal sale to Alcoa ongoing - SEPI.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Inespal sale to Alcoa ongoing - SEPI.

text.p: State holding group Sociedad Estatal de Participaciones Industriales (SEPI) said on Tuesday talks with Aluminum Company of America (Alcoa) on the sale of Spanish aluminum group Inespal are ongoing.
"(This sale) remains open awaiting specifics on some parts of the operation," SEPI said.
SEPI, which controls Inespal, presented key parts of an Alcoa business design for Inespal that foresees investments of some 64.59 billion pesetas in the next 10 years.
The investments are destined to increasing production and fitting Inespal with environmental measures alread applied at Alcoa plants.
SEPI said should the operation make progress, Inespal would represent 50 percent of Alcoa's European business volume.
Last February, Alcoa and SEPI signed a preliminary agreement for Alcoa to buy Inespal's main businesses by the end of 1997.
The deal would not include the sale of Inespal Conversion in Linares nor the factory at Ferroperfil.
